programs.title: Smoke \u0026 Steel
programs.desc: The industrial revolution changed the world.Although often unconsciously, we still benefit from the achievements of this era - groundbreaking designs, inventions and discoveries.One of them is the excavation of a tunnel under the Thames.The success of this venture initiated the construction of underground structures.Urban planning works in Prague had a huge impact on the rapid development of European cities.In turn, the creation of planetary observatories changed human perception of the universe.The use of steam engines had an impact on many areas of life, including:for the development of transport and tourism.The Trans-Siberian Railway, a desperate attempt to connect the east and west of the great Russian territory, had an impact on the outcome of the war, and a warship off the southern coast of England contributed to a change in naval warfare tactics.The program presents not only those structures that are still in use, but also those that are historical attractions.

programs.title: Impossible Railways
programs.desc: A story about the most spectacular structures and railway lines in the world, which captivate the viewer with bold engineering solutions.In the 19th century, the railway was the most modern branch of the economy.Railway designers fearlessly conquered mountain trails, crossed rushing rivers and changed the architecture of cities to build solid tracks.The document will present breakthrough events in the history of this field of transport and the profiles of railway pioneers who, often contrary to nature and physics, created eye-catching structures.

programs.title: Boys From Brazil: The Rise of the Bolsonaros
programs.desc: The story of the extraordinary success of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, who rose from the political fringes to the most important position in the country.Since his spectacular victory in 2018, Bolsonaro has barely left the headlines.This is due to his highly controversial views on gender equality, sexuality, indigenous rights and the Amazon.Despite numerous opponents, it still attracts millions to whom it presents a new vision of Brazil as a country based on national sovereignty and solid economic growth.Politics' path to ruthless power, presented in conversations with supporters and opponents, is a story about the backstage of politics, the power of family, weapons and God.

programs.title: The Kingdom: The World's Most Powerful Prince: Game of Thrones
programs.desc: The story of the rise to power of Mohammed Bin Salman - the leader of Saudi Arabia, the largest oil exporter in the world and the most influential country in the Middle East.Although he is formally the heir to the throne, he exercises power in the country and will probably rule for decades to come.As a young leader, he initiated changes to many customs in society since the country was founded in 1932.He led, among others,to greater integration between women and men.However, his rise to power involved kidnappings, torture and murder.Diplomats, spies, Western observers and residents of Saudi Arabia who spoke on the program recall meetings with him and tell how he outsmarted his rivals on his way to power.
